hooks.name: matching-tests
hooks.description: On save of lib/matching.ts, a file under lib/matching/, or lib/safety.ts / lib/safety-*.ts, run the matching and safety test files (golden, property, unit). No --passWithNoTests: if the files are missing the run fails loudly.

action.command: npx vitest run tests/matching tests/safety 1>&2 || { echo 'MATCHING/SAFETY TESTS FAILED: fix the code or raise a spec change; never loosen a golden case.' >&2; exit 1; }
